title: Jasper Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Cozy Jasper cottage offers enjoyable outdoor space, tucked within a natural setting just a short stroll away from area pools and attractions.
description_expanded: 153 TUPELO STREET*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.Classic Seaside Cottage in a Prime, Walkable LocationWelcome to Jasper Cottage, a timeless Seaside retreat tucked into a peaceful, natural setting on Seaside’s east side. Perfectly positioned just a short stroll from the beach, downtown Seaside, and the community pools, this charming cottage offers the ideal blend of privacy and proximity. Surrounded by lush greenery and mature shade, Jasper feels comfortably secluded while keeping Seaside’s best amenities right at your fingertips.Wraparound Screened Porch for Relaxed Coastal LivingOne of Jasper Cottage’s most beloved features is its expansive wraparound screened porch, designed for effortless outdoor living. This serene space invites you to enjoy casual meals, unwind with a good book in the hammock, or sway gently on the porch swing after a long day at the beach. Ceiling fans and cooling coastal breezes make this porch a favorite gathering spot from morning coffee to evening wind-downs.Open Living Spaces with Soaring CeilingsInside, the main level offers a welcoming layout with soaring ceilings that enhance the light and airy feel of the home. A comfortable sitting area provides space to relax, while a custom built-in dining table creates the perfect setting for shared meals. The nearby kitchen is thoughtfully equipped with ample cabinetry and all the essentials needed for easy vacation living.Flexible Sleeping Arrangements for Families and GroupsJust off the main living area, a secondary family room offers exceptional flexibility. This space easily converts into a private sleeping area with a queen-size sleeper sofa and an adjacent full bathroom—ideal for guests who prefer main-level accommodations.Upstairs, the second level reveals a spacious king primary bedroom alongside a welcoming queen bedroom featuring a daybed with a twin trundle. These rooms share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom and comfortably accommodate families or groups, allowing Jasper Cottage to sleep up to eight guests with ease.Walkable Access to Seaside AmenitiesLocated on Seaside’s eastern side, Jasper Cottage places you within walking distance of the beach, tennis courts, fitness center, swimming pools, and the charming shops and dining of downtown Seaside. Whether you’re heading out for a morning swim, an afternoon workout, or an evening stroll through town, everything you love about Seaside is just moments away.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,160 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on 30A176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessQueen sleeper sofaWasher & dryerPeacock Alley Linens with fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking policy: Only 1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001887
